arguments.record: Decision Record for UC-3f34b6: Summary: The Communications team proposes an assistant to draft initial versions of press releases from internal reports and briefing notes. The system will be used by 10 staff members, with an expected benefit of reducing draft time by half. Risk Level: Limited. Controls: All drafts will be reviewed and approved by a communications officer. Pattern: Assistant on managed platform. Monthly Cost Range: $0.6 - $1.2 USD. Recommendation: Approve.
